card.name: Four-colourings of complete graphs without monochromatic hexagons (R_4(C6))

task.name: Four-colourings of complete graphs without monochromatic hexagons (R_4(C6))
task.description: construct() -> {'n': n, 'colors': [...]}: one colour in {0,1,2,3} for each pair (i,j), i<j, of vertices 0..n-1 in lexicographic order, 1 <= n <= 20. No colour class may contain a six-cycle (exact search for not necessarily induced cycles). Maximize n. A valid 4-colouring of K_n certifies R_4(C6) > n. The best known colouring has 17 vertices; 18 or 19 vertices would be new.
